market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1–3 month window. Oil spike, AUD weakness, and rate-rise fears create headwinds. Iron ore weakness caps materials. RBA policy uncertainty and housing correction add volatility. Expect choppy, risk-off tape with selective energy and gold outperformance.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and RBA pivots. Housing correction may create first-home buyer policy stimulus. ANZ restructuring and mining capex rationalisation could support earnings recovery. Superannuation reform debate may create policy tailwinds for financials. Key risk: prolonged iron ore downturn and global growth deceleration.
